metadata.title: Fusion 360 CAD Mesh Operations - Complete Enumeration
metadata.description: Comprehensive parameter catalog for Fusion 360 Design workspace mesh operations: import (Insert Mesh), conversion (Convert to BRep), decimation (Reduce), smoothing (Smooth), healing (Repair), splitting (Plane Cut), and local edits (Erase and Fill). Aligns with Autodesk Fusion 360 Python API MeshFeatures + MeshBody surface.
metadata.source: Autodesk Fusion 360 Help — Design workspace > Mesh > Modify panel + Python API MeshFeatures reference

commonTabs.description: Standard parameter tabs for mesh operations

INSERT_MESH.description: Imports an external mesh file (OBJ / STL / 3MF) into the active design as a mesh body. Supports unit scaling, axis remapping (Y-up vs Z-up), and merge-coplanar-faces optimization.

parameters.name: File Path
parameters.description: Local file path to .obj / .stl / .3mf

parameters.name: File Format
parameters.description: Forced format override (auto-detected from extension)

parameters.name: Unit Type
parameters.description: Source mesh's unit assumption

parameters.name: Up Axis
parameters.description: Source mesh's up direction (auto-rotate to Fusion's Z-up)

parameters.name: Merge Coplanar Faces
parameters.description: Combine adjacent triangles on the same plane (saves triangle count)

parameters.name: Place At
parameters.description: Where the mesh origin lands

parameters.name: Insertion Point
parameters.description: Sketch point / vertex for selected_point mode

parameters.name: Scale Factor
parameters.description: Uniform scale applied after unit conversion

CONVERT_TO_BREP.description: Converts a mesh body to a faceted BRep solid. Each triangle becomes a planar face. Use sparingly — output BRep has very high face count (one per triangle); preferable to first Reduce + Smooth, then Convert.

parameters.name: Mesh Bodies
parameters.description: Mesh body / bodies to convert

parameters.name: Output Type
parameters.description: Faceted (every triangle = face) or stitched (planar regions = face)

parameters.name: Stitch Tolerance
parameters.description: Coplanar tolerance for stitched_planar mode

parameters.name: Preserve Mesh
parameters.description: Keep the original mesh body alongside the new BRep

parameters.name: Warn On Triangle Count
parameters.description: Confirmation prompt threshold (0 = no prompt)

REDUCE.description: Decimates the mesh to a lower triangle count while preserving overall shape. Three target modes: target triangle count, target percentage, or target deviation. Supports edge-length and curvature-aware preservation.

parameters.name: Target Triangle Count
parameters.description: Final triangle count (triangle_count mode)

parameters.name: Target Percentage
parameters.description: Fraction of original to keep (0..1, percentage mode)

parameters.name: Max Deviation
parameters.description: Maximum allowed deviation (deviation mode)

parameters.name: Preserve Boundaries
parameters.description: Lock open boundary edges

parameters.name: Preserve Sharp Edges
parameters.description: Detect and preserve sharp creases above angle threshold

parameters.name: Sharp Edge Angle
parameters.description: Crease detection threshold

SMOOTH.description: Laplacian (or Taubin λ-μ) smoothing of mesh vertices. Reduces noise from scan data. Iteration count controls strength. Supports masking by face selection so only selected regions are smoothed.

parameters.name: Mask Faces
parameters.description: Optional subset of faces to smooth (rest are locked)

parameters.name: Iterations
parameters.description: Number of smoothing passes

parameters.name: Smoothness Factor
parameters.description: λ — Laplacian step (0..1)

parameters.name: Shrinkage Factor
parameters.description: μ — Taubin reverse step (taubin only, must be > λ)

REPAIR.description: Heals invalid mesh topology. Detects and fixes: holes (fill), non-manifold edges (split or remove), self-intersections (resolve), duplicate vertices (merge), inverted normals (flip), small components (delete). Choose individual fixes or run all.

parameters.name: Hole Max Boundary Length
parameters.description: Don't fill holes whose perimeter exceeds this (selective mode)

parameters.name: Delete Small Components
parameters.description: Remove disconnected mesh components below threshold

parameters.name: Component Triangle Threshold
parameters.description: Components with fewer triangles are deleted (delete_small_components mode)

PLANE_CUT.description: Splits a mesh body using a plane. Resulting halves are independently selectable. Optionally fill the cross-section with a triangulated cap to keep the body watertight.

parameters.name: Cut Plane
parameters.description: Construction plane / planar face

parameters.name: Cut Direction
parameters.description: Which side to keep / discard / split

parameters.name: Fill Cross-Section
parameters.description: Cap the cut with new triangles (watertight result)

parameters.name: Cross-Section Resolution
parameters.description: Edge length for cap triangles

parameters.name: Plane Offset
parameters.description: Distance from cut_plane (signed)

ERASE_AND_FILL.description: Local mesh edit: deletes selected faces and fills the resulting hole with new triangulation. Used to clean noisy regions, remove undesired protrusions, or rebuild non-manifold patches.

parameters.name: Faces to Erase
parameters.description: Triangles or face groups to delete

parameters.name: Tangent Chain
parameters.description: Auto-extend to tangent-connected faces

parameters.name: Fill Method
parameters.description: Hole-filling algorithm

parameters.name: Refinement Level
parameters.description: Number of subdivision passes on the fill triangulation

parameters.name: Preserve Boundary Continuity
parameters.description: Match the curvature of adjacent retained faces

platform_notes.mesh_workspace_subtab: Mesh operations live under Design > Mesh subworkspace, accessible only when a mesh body is in the active document
platform_notes.convert_to_brep_caveat: Faceted BRep output has one face per triangle — Fusion warns at 100k triangles by default because downstream operations (fillet, pattern, shell) become slow and may fail
platform_notes.smooth_taubin_lambda_mu_constraint: Taubin λ-μ smoothing requires μ > λ for non-shrinking behavior; default 0.5 / 0.55 is canonical from Taubin's 1995 SIGGRAPH paper
platform_notes.stl_binary_preferred: STL binary is ~6× smaller than ASCII for equivalent triangle count
